_comment: Stands in for GET membership/v2/companies/{companyGuid} on the JustLogin membership API.
Captured verbatim from the dev environment, so Stub and Live answer identically for this company.
It exists for one value: companyId. The identity server's token request takes CompanyID, not the
company GUID, and that mapping is the only thing the membership call is for.
Note status: -3 — whatever that means, it is what dev returns for this company today.
